content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products like Notion templates for crypto requires a reliable payment infrastructure, but traditional platforms like Gumroad or Payhip come with fees that can eat into your profits. By using a sovereign stack like COREMERCH's, you're not just avoiding these fees — you're also ensuring that you own your digital commerce infrastructure, giving you control over how your data is stored, processed, and delivered. This is infrastructure sovereignty in action, allowing you to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack without relying on any platform.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's sovereign stacks are built on top of free and open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive. These tools work together to provide a seamless payment processing experience, automatically verifying crypto transactions in real-time and delivering your digital products to customers instantly. With NOWPayments' 0.5% fee, you can keep more of your earnings while still enjoying the convenience of a reliable payment infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's sovereign stacks are designed for digital creators like you who want to sell their digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms. Whether you're selling Notion templates, ebooks, courses, or other digital products, these stacks provide a flexible and scalable infrastructure that lets you focus on what matters most — creating and selling your products. By choosing a sovereign stack, you're taking control of your digital commerce infrastructure and building a more sustainable business model.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A sovereign stack like COREMERCH's consists of several key components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring that transactions are secure and reliable. By combining these components, you get a seamless payment processing experience that's tailored to your specific needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign stack like COREMERCH's today, start by choosing the products you want to sell and the payment methods you want to support. Next, select the components that best fit your needs and configure them according to the documentation provided. Finally, connect your payment gateway to NOWPayments and test your infrastructure to ensure that everything is working as expected. With COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack — all in one convenient package.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
